meta.question: on CUB final seeds 1, 2, 3, is the Full KD - CE accuracy difference resolvable on 600 val images (per-image discordance vs seed noise), and do Full KD students agree with the teacher more than CE?
meta.method: per-image paired correctness (McNemar), same-method seed-pair discordance as noise reference, image bootstrap of seed-averaged difference, teacher-argmax agreement and KL(T||S)
meta.paper: Hinton et al. 2015 (KD); Stanton et al. NeurIPS 2021 (student-teacher fidelity); Dietterich 1998 (McNemar for classifier comparison); Bouthillier et al. MLSys 2021 (variance sources)
